texts.name: Artemis
texts.biography: Artemis was once a trail guide on the sun-scorched borders of Astral. Her patient eye and unerring aim made her the natural leader of the Deserted Shooters who now guard those lonely roads.

specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Deserted Shooters or Deserted Hunters for each level attained after 2nd level.
specialty.name: Deserted Shooters
